kpis.signal: Plus gros segment Fortive, marques Fluke / Accruent / Gordian, leader instrumentation et logiciels facility management
kpis.description_fr: CA segment IOS : instrumentation Fluke + logiciels facility / asset management (Accruent, Gordian, eMaint). Activite la plus rentable du portefeuille Fortive.
kpis.description_en: IOS segment revenue: Fluke instrumentation + facility/asset management software (Accruent, Gordian, eMaint). Most profitable Fortive segment.

kpis.signal: Segment a scinder via spin-off Ralliant (annonce 2024, finalisation 2025) : instruments de precision pour industrie et test
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Precision Technologies : instruments de mesure et de test (Tektronix, Fluke Networks). Segment a etre scinde en societe independante Ralliant en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Precision Technologies segment revenue: precision measurement and test instruments (Tektronix, Fluke Networks). To be spun off as Ralliant in 2025.

kpis.signal: Sterilisation et workflow hopitaux (Censis, Fluke Biomedical, ASP). Segment defensif lie au volume chirurgical.
kpis.description_fr: CA segment AHS : equipements et logiciels sterilisation hopitaux + workflow chirurgical (Censis Tag, Fluke Biomedical, Advanced Sterilization Products). Demande tiree par volume chirurgical hospitalier.
kpis.description_en: AHS segment revenue: hospital sterilization equipment and software + surgical workflow (Censis Tag, Fluke Biomedical, Advanced Sterilization Products). Driven by hospital surgical volume.

kpis.signal: Croissance composee ~7%/an FY20-24, mix acquisitions + croissance organique single-digit
kpis.description_fr: CA total Fortive (3 segments). Croissance composee ~7,7% par an entre 2020 et 2024 portee par M&A bolt-on et croissance organique 2-4%.
kpis.description_en: Total Fortive revenue (3 segments). 7.7% CAGR FY20-24 driven by bolt-on M&A and 2-4% organic growth.
